Good morning Dr Binkle.

that. But what I want to know is how do we know how much fat we have in our body?

I mean, that’s 180 years ago.

up. The second also involves the blood as we find that people with obesity have high cholesterol and… Yes, there is a lot more public awareness about levels of cholesterol these days.
